claims.claim: Young largemouth ate 58-93 % of littoral bluegill fry at Ridge Lake, Illinois (Santucci & Wahl 2003, via Neuswanger et al. 2015)
claims.note: Full text not obtained. The relay was checked by another reader: Neuswanger et al. 2015 (docs/paper/evidence/Neuswanger_etal_2015.json) do write '58-93% of littoral zone bluegill fry' for 14-acre Ridge Lake, with young largemouth (≤ age 3) averaging 179/acre in 1987-1989. The paper already labels it 'via'.

claims.claim: young largemouth at about 442/ha consumed 58-93 % of the littoral bluegill fry in an Illinois lake (Santucci & Wahl 2003, via a secondary review)
claims.note: Full text not obtained. 442/ha is 179/acre × 2.471 (correct conversion of Neuswanger et al.'s relayed figure, which is for largemouth ≤ age 3, 1987-1989). Name the secondary review (Neuswanger et al. 2015) here as in §3.6.5.
